scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --ignore-pattern 'apps/portal/lint-fixtures/**' && oxfmt --check && node scripts/check-tsconfig.mjs && node scripts/check-template-immutability.mjs
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @transfer/db run seed && pnpm --filter @transfer/api run seed
scripts.db:reset: pnpm --filter @transfer/db run reset && pnpm --filter @transfer/api run seed
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-client/openapi.json packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts packages/config/schema packages/config/templates/manifest.json docs/domain/generated
